description: Connects to a Coalesce environment, discovers its nodes (SQL transforms), and builds one Dagster asset per node with dependencies mirroring the Coalesce DAG. Materializing an asset triggers and polls a Coalesce run for that node, and surfaces Coalesce's Node-level/column-level test results as a Dagster asset check.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per Coalesce node, plus a coalesce_node_tests AssetCheckResult per node when emit_test_checks is enabled (default).

api_token_env_var.description: Env var with Coalesce API token
api_token_env_var.label: API Token Env Var

assets_by_node_name.label: Assets By Node Name
assets_by_node_name.description: Per-node AssetSpec overrides (key/description/group_name/owners/metadata/tags/deps/kinds); a node may map to a list of overrides to fan out into multiple assets.

emit_test_checks.label: Emit Test Checks
emit_test_checks.description: Emit a coalesce_node_tests AssetCheckResult per node from Coalesce's per-run hasTestFailures flag (GET /api/v1/runs/{runID}/results).

fail_run_on_test_failure.label: Fail Run On Test Failure
fail_run_on_test_failure.description: Hard-fail the Dagster run if any node's tests failed, regardless of that test's own halt-on-failure setting in Coalesce. Coalesce's own per-test halt config already decides whether a failure stops the pipeline, so this is only for teams that want Dagster to enforce it unconditionally.

include_catalog_metadata.label: Include Catalog Metadata
include_catalog_metadata.description: Enrich each asset's description/owners/tags/column lineage from Coalesce's separately-licensed Catalog (Castor) product. Best-effort: fails soft if Catalog isn't provisioned or the call errors.

catalog_api_token_env_var.label: Catalog API Token Env Var
catalog_api_token_env_var.description: Env var with a Coalesce Catalog (Castor) API token. Required only when include_catalog_metadata is true.

catalog_base_url.label: Catalog Base URL
catalog_base_url.description: Coalesce Catalog GraphQL API base URL. EU default; US-hosted Catalog tenants use api.us.castordoc.com/public/graphql.

name: Coalesce Workspace
